articles.title: Deal registration: what to expect
articles.summary: A practical guide to submitting an opportunity and following its review without losing the important details.
steps: Confirm the end customer, opportunity scope, expected close date, and your role in the sale before submitting.
Submit one registration for the opportunity. Include enough context for the channel team to distinguish it from existing records.
Use the registration ID to check progress. Needs information means an owner has asked for a specific detail before review can continue.
Approval and any pricing or eligibility decision are made by the appropriate human team. A status lookup cannot promise an outcome.
